title: Data-axis escalation: uniform cap 612 and the all-available corpus (409,832 rows) on the sealed construction
question: M140 PASSED (+50% rows -> +0.0161). Does the data axis keep paying to the corpus's full extent: Q(6144, 211140) at the uniform cap 612 and Q(6144, 409832) at ALL available raw rows per class?

sparse.note: M117/M126 exact construction, unchanged; M141 adds rows only.

extension.premise: measured before dispatch: per-class raw train counts min 612, median 1193, total 409832; no class below 612
extension.all_available_note: per class, ALL raw-train rows (raw array order) NOT in the sealed 400-row subsample. NON-UNIFORM schedule, disclosed. The first 69000 extension rows are exactly the sealed M140 ext600 selection and are REUSED from the sealed ext600 memmap (never re-encoded), verified by the t2 anchor.

anchors.t2_reference: Q(6144, 207000) = 0.24066666666666667 (sealed M140, via the reused ext600 memmap)

gate.kill_switch_data_full: fired if Q(6144, 409832) - 0.24066666666666667 < +0.005. Fired: the data axis saturates between 207k and the full corpus (negative sealed). Passed: the data lever holds to the corpus's full extent.
